monuments.name: Launch Site
monuments.summary: Large high-risk monument with strong loot, heavy radiation, and frequent PvP.
tips: Bring strong radiation protection and enough meds.
Expect counters near main loot routes and recycler paths.

monuments.name: Airfield
monuments.summary: Open monument with underground card puzzle, recycler access, and wide PvP sightlines.
tips: Move carefully between hangars because sightlines are long.
Check recycler area before committing to loot.

monuments.name: Water Treatment Plant
monuments.summary: Reliable mid-game monument with recycler, puzzle loot, and many approach angles.
tips: Use elevation and rooftops to scout before looting.
The monument has many third-party angles, so avoid tunnel vision.

monuments.name: Satellite Dish
monuments.summary: Simple early monument with recycler, green-card puzzle value, and modest contest risk.
tips: Good early stop for components and a recycler run.
Dish structures give quick cover but limited escape routes.

monuments.name: Train Yard
monuments.summary: Strong monument with card progression, recycler, and dangerous vertical angles.
tips: Control rooflines before starting puzzle routes.
Train cars and buildings create many close-range ambush spots.

monuments.name: Dome
monuments.summary: Fast parkour monument with exposed climbing route and useful early loot.
tips: You are exposed while climbing, so scout before going up.
Falling is often more dangerous than the monument itself.
